notes.note: CDT left the game in the last term with some calf tightness. Just the 6 disposals and 6 hit outs before that.
Duft-Tytler had his second best score for the year which was mainly due to his 80% efficiency. The price rise this week should be enough reason to move him on.
Duff-Tytler was back in the side this week but just the 9 disposals and 4 tackles for him . He made his BE but he is one we need to be upgrading.
CDT had a tough day with 1.3 from just 10 disposals. His scoring isn't enough to hold him.
CDT is now a must trade and is unfieldable with his last three all 55 or less.
Cooper had another tough game and he is losing value.  Move him on if you can.
This was always the concern with CDT in that he appears to have a longer term average in the 30-40 range with that one big score being an anomaly.
CDT came back to earth this week and posted his second lowest score showing us that previous week could have been a one off.

CDT was the only eagle to hit 100 in the win. This was a big turn around from the 37 in his first game. You can wait another week though if you want as it would be prudent to see another big score from the rookie.
CDT didn't do enough for us to warrant him in our teams as anything other than an R3 who won't make us enough cash to trade out.
Duursma just keeps producing with 20 disposals and 7 tackles this week. He is having a great first season and is a safe player to have on field.

Duursma is certainly growing as a key player for the Eagles but his score didn't really represent how good his game looked. Just the 12 disposals and goal but he will certainly be good value for your bench.
Duursma returned to the side but an efficiency of just 41% for his 12 disposals saw the first score under 65 for his career.
Solid game from Duursma with the only blemish his 6 clangers and 52% efficiency.
Duursma had his best score since round 5 thanks to his 25 disposals and 7 marks to go with a goal.  Keep him as one of your last upgrades if you can.
Duursma had his fourth over 80 in the last five games but his BE is now up over 70 which means you are now holding him as a point scorer and not a cash generator.
Duursma had his lowest score of the season with his 20 disposals coming at 65%. Nothing to be concerned at however that BE has now risen to 85. He would be one of the last rookies to upgrade though.
Duursma just keeps rolling on. He is no longer a cash cow though as he won't make much more with his BE but he is still very much worth his spot on your team and is fieldable.
Duursma had the third best score for the Eagles this week from his 11 marks and 25 disposals. His BE remains manageable for him so keep riding him.

Was Duursma the one we missed? Yeah for most people as they baulked at his high price. Those that started him have been rewarded as he continues to post some great scores. His BE remains very achievable at 44.
Duursma continues to show us that he should have been in our teams despite the high price tag. He continues to impress and will be one you can possibly hold til his bye if he keeps this up.
Duursma had the fourth best score for the Eagles and was their only multiple goal kicker in the heavy loss to the Swans. This is a good sign that he can still score when the team is struggling.

Duursma has shown that paying up for him this year has been the right play as he recorded his first 100+ score. He could have gone higher as he kicked 3 behinds to go with his 1 goal and 20 disposals.
Duursma showed us why he was the number 1 pick with a second great score. His BE says you can still get him in as his price will rise after this week's game against the Power.

Duursma's first game was a tough one for his team but he did well with 14 disposals and 5 tackles. If you didn't start him you don't need to jump just yet. You can wait to see what happens next week still.

injury_suspension_status_text: Concussion. Out for season.
Quad. Expected to be available for round 24.

notes.note: Ginbey injured a quad just as he was looking good. Must trade.

injury_suspension_status_text: Quad. Expected to be available for round 20.

notes.note: 15 touches with 12 being kicks for Lindsay. His BE was huge and won't come down too much after this one so He is still on your trade out list.
Lindsay has now had back to back scores in the 50s. This is a concern with his BE still rising. He should be on the list to upgrade.
Lindsay only just missed his BE number and it was his second lowest score of the season so far. His BE has risen to 81 and this will stifle his cash growth going forward.
17 kicks and 2 handballs for Lindsay as he has taken either the most or equal most kick ins over 4 of the last 5 weeks and he played on every time.
Good game for Lindsay as he posted 24 disposals at 83%. He has been scoring well but with the 132 leaving his cycle this week that BE has risen to 80
Lindsay didn't have the huge score of last week but he still had a good outing with his value jumping on the back of his 17 disposal game. He should be good to hold til the byes.
Lindsay was huge with 31 disposals at 90% this week with one out of the box. His BE has now dropped to -24 meaning he will make some great cash over the coming weeks.
Lindsay continues to have some solid scoring with his 19 disposals and goal this week. He has a great BE still and is fieldable.
This was the best for the season for Lindsay which repaid owners who held him when he was dropped. His BE remains low so will make us some more cash now.
It was a tough day for the Eagles and this was reflected in Lindsay's score being his lowest. His BE was negative so no damage but when the Eagles lose big his score won't be high.
Lindsay returned to the side and rewarded those that held him with a handy 70 from 19 disposals. Just beware that the opposition should be tougher going forward.
Lindsay was dropped from the team which isn't a good sign. If you held and he isn't named this week then move him on.
Lindsay was heavily selected and was good with his 16 disposals. This was around the level scoring that we were expecting from him.

injury_suspension_status_text: Knee. Out for season.

notes.note: McCarthy was the best for the Eagles with 31 disposals and 11 marks. He is showing great form and is one you can rely on.
McCarthy has been over 100 in four of his last six games which is making him a great starting selection.
Lowest for the season for McCarthy. He missed his BE and his new one of 124 is a big issue.
McCarthy was the best for the Eagles from his 30 disposals. Back to back 100+ for the first time this year for him.
McCarthy picked up where he left off last season with another solid showing. He may not be one we get in yet but those that started him won't be too unhappy.

injury_suspension_status_text: Foot. Out for season.
Knee. Out for season.

notes.note: Wilmot was huge with 12 marks and 32 disposals. Easily his best of the year. But hold off until we see another game of this standard with his previous 5 only averaging 77.
Harley had some huge moments in a very impressive game as he racked up 16 contested possessions and 9 clearances from his 27 disposals. This was his first over 100 since round 10.

Harley gave away 6 free kicks which really hurt his score as did his 52% efficiency. This really hurt his score as he did have 18 contested possessions and 6 clearances. Yet to have a ton in his last 6 games.
Reid was one of the few shining lights for the Eagles as he led the game in clearances with 12 but he gave away 4 free kicks which hurt. This extended his below 100 scoring streak to 5 games.

Reid posted another of his low scores this week as he fell back into the habit of giving away free kicks as there were four this week. He also had 7 clangers. He will have games like this so don't panic.
Reid was quiet in the second term but did come good in the last term as the Eagles made their charge. He matched last week's score and is still looking a good option.
After a big second quarter Reid had a quiet second half with just 24 points coming from it. He wasn't helped by giving away 4 free kicks. Good return to scoring after the previous week's drop.

Reid had 20 disposals and he gave away 4 free kicks. This broke his run of 100+ scores and he also delivered his second lowest score of the season. If you own no need to trade out based on this one game.
Harley Reid not only went over 100 for three games in a row now but he posted a massive game with 34 disposals 8 tackles and 19 clearances and 10 clearances.
Reid had his first back to back scores over 100 this week from his 21 disposals coming at 81% and a goal. Importantly he gave away just the 1 free kick this week.
Harley posted his second over 100 for the season with his 26 disposals and 2 goals but it could have been so much more as he had 11 clangers and gave away 5 free kicks.

Reid was tagged by Garcia and had 19 of his 27 disposals by hand. He still led his team in clearances with 7. His scoring is not looking like reaching heights so this is about what we can expect from him.
Reid continues to give us middling type scores. He is going to find it tough in the Eagles side to score well unfortunately. 20 touches at 65% for him as it was tough in the Derby.
22 disposals and a goal for Harley to go with a goal. He is going to continue to get attention from the opposition and he seems to have settled in this scoring zone rather than going big.
Reid was tagged by Jordon for the game and became very frustrated ending with 17 disposals at 64%. He is susceptible to a tag so these scores could come more often.
Reid has put in his best score of the year which was aided by 2 goals. He is getting the highest CBAs for his side this year at 86%.
30 touches for Harley but 3 frees against and 9 clangers really dragged that score down.
Reid again had his issues with the umpires giving away 3 free kicks.

injury_suspension_status_text: ACL. Out for season.

notes.note: Dev Rob was back this week and had the third best score for the Eagles but he left the game late with a knee issue which was iced up. It has been revealed he has torn an ACL and now will miss the rest of the season. Trade.
Robertson will return this week from suspension so hopefully you held.
Robertson had the job blanketing Butters but following a dangerous tackle he will be missing this week. Given his money making potential he is one that we need to hold through this one week.
Dev Rob was again fantastic and he had the second most points for the Eagles. He is proving to be the great pick that we all suspected with a great role.
Robertson's first game for the Eagles was a good one with a huge 12 tackles. At his price he is a must have.
Shoenberg had 12 disposals but not enough points came from them.
Williams was up against Lobb this week and won the hit out battle with 35but did have just the 6 disposals.
Williams is still providing some good scoring but he isn't one that you would trust on field as a ruck but he is posting respectable F6 numbers.

Just 15 points at half time but a couple of goals in the second half helped his score. If you are still holding it is time to upgrade to one of the key rucks unless you are holding him as your ruck cover.
Williams had a tough task with Xerri but managed to get one of just three scores over 100 for the Eagles this week. 14 disposals and 26 hit outs with a game high 8 to advantage.
Williams was better this week against Sweet posting a 92 with 29 hit outs and 12 disposals.

A fall back to the scoring we have been used to for Williams this week with his 11 disposals 17 hit outs and goal. He could still rise in value this week with a good BE but it could be the end of the road after that.

Back to back huge scores for Williams with his 18 contested possessions and 12 clearances along with his 20 disposals. It is still a risk that his scoring could disappear at any moment but ride the wave if you won him.
One out of the box for Williams from 41 hit outs 2 goals 7 clearances and 9 tackles. This won't happen every week but if Darcy Cameron isn't back for Collingwood this week he could go big again.
Williams was better but you aren't going to want him in your side for too long.
We were worried about people trading him in after that good score and it turned out to be with good reason. Just 13 hitouts and 7 disposals for his 58.
Yeo was out of the game just before half time with a groin issue which is a real concern. If you have him then you need to trade him.
Scerri managed 9 handballs and no kicks this week but all were effective making it an ok score which also kept his BE low.

Derkson came on to the field for a number of coaches that had Whitfield and unfortunately he didn't do what we hoped. This is the lowest we have seen from him this season from his 10 kicks and 3 handballs.
Derkson had just 11 disposals and 6 marks and he has been hanging around this level of scoring of late. He will be ok bench cover for us if he can keep this up.

Derksen got off to a hot start with 36 in the first term but just 3 in the second and -1 in the last was disappointing for owners. His score was still good enough to keep his BE negative and with the lack of cash generation yet he is one to hold through the Blues bye if you can.
Derksen played his third game and it was his best score of the season. His value rose and his BE remains low at -21. Not too late to get him in if you need him.
Derksen played his first game and posted 11 disposals and 4 marks. It wasn't a score that made us say we have to pick him but if he can do it
Zadow's first game saw just 3 disposals and 5 tackles. He doesn't look to be one we can consider.

injury_suspension_status_text: Personal. Expected return to be confirmed.

notes.note: Best of the season for Hollands with his 25 disposals and 2 goals. Just beware that his other two scores have been in the 60s.

injury_suspension_status_text: Concussion. Expected to be available for round 20.

notes.note: Blamires posted just 13 disposals and missed his BE by some distance and has lost value. If he retains his spot in the side he must be traded.
Blamires finished with 16 disposals as he just got past his BE.  His new one of 60 is a problem as he is averaging 60 over the last three games.
Blamires came back in to the side this week and did make the most of it with 17 disposals. He made his BE comfortably but you need to move him on still.
16 kicks and 5 handballs for Blamires. His BE remains low this week with his lowest for the season about to drop out of his cycle. He is a hold
Blamires shook off last week's low score to get back to the range we have been used to seeing in his first three games.

Blamires didn't have a huge outing but his 15 disposals still sees his price rise despite this being his lowest of the season. Nothing to be concerned about but he may only have a few more weeks in our side.
Blamires gave us his best score of the season and ensured his BE remains negative and he will be a great cash cow for us.
Blamires is proving to be a great selection with his 16 disposals and 6 tackles this week. He is providing great scoring across these bye rounds.
Murdock had just the 13 touches as he has gone from a player we want on the field to one we can only just rely on for bench cover as he hasn't been over 60 in the last four.
This is three in a row now in the 50s for Murdock which is a concern for owners looking to use him as F6. He is one that you should be looping off the bench where you can.

Murdock has really put the brakes on his scoring over the last two games with both being in the low 50s. He was playing as a defensive forward again this week which is really hurting his scores. Ideally you would be looping his scores where possible.

Murdock has been inconsistent in scoring of late as he had 16 disposals this week as he was playing as a defensive forward. He is still one to hold though. His BE is up at 61 but he should be one of our last upgrades.
Another week and we have seen a defensive role from Murdock. This time he was tasked with Roberts. He still managed to score well kicking 3 goals from his 19 disposals.
Murdock had jobs again this week with time spent with Josh Daicos and then Pendlebury but this time he was able to rack up 22 disposals and a goal. He posted his second best score of the season.
Murdock posted his lowest score for the year which was due to his change in role where he tagged Whitfield for the game.  He had just 1 point in the first term. Hopefully this was a one off.
Murdock had his best score since his debut game with 25 disposals this week and 7 contested. This has seen his BE dropping to 30
Just the 16 touches for Murdock as he hasn't recaptured the form he had before his injury. His BE has jumped to 41 and this may force us to make a decision soon.
Murdock had his lowest but it was a poor game from the Eagles. 20 disposals for him and his cash generation has been slowed but certainly not stopped.
We had been waiting for a few weeks for Murdock to return. His great BE remains after his 8 tackles and 19 disposals delivered another high score.
Murdock was one of the highest traded in players this week and he didn't let us down with 92 points but will now miss 1-2 weeks with a hamstring injury.
Murdock came in for his first game and he top scored for the Eagles! You don't have to get him in this week but he must be on your watch list for after his second game.
Cross was brought in by a number of coaches in recent weeks but this was his second lowest score of the season from his 6 disposals and his BE is now up at 31 which is a concern.
Solid for Perez and this is about what you would expect to get from him most weeks.
Perez came back into the side but he will find it hard to hold his spot on the back of his 9 possession game. He isn't one you can rely on.
Perez was back to the sort of score we saw when he was in the team earlier in the season. His value rose and his BE dropped to 32 which helps us hold him.
Perez was a late in but managed just the 9 disposals whilst giving away 4 free kicks. He rose in value thanks to that negative BE but now has one of 21.
Flynn Perez was dropped this week so we couldn't capitalise on his negative break even.
Perez had his lowest of the season but only just. He has been hanging around the 50s to 60s. His BE remains negative meaning you could still get him this week if you are in need of a def downgrade.
Burton had the 8 disposals and only just hit his BE. Unfortunately if you are holding him he isn't scoring enough and a new BE of 31 means he will likely lose money this week.
Burton copped a knock to his shoulder but did have 9 disposals. His score has seen his BE now rise sharply to 33 which isn't what we had hoped for from him.
Burton's third game netted just 9 disposals and his BE has now risen to -16. Not ideal for owners but if you do still want him he is still cheap.
Hugo is certainly a player you should be considering looping off your bench each week where you are able. He will be on field for a lot of Whitfield owners this week.
While this was his lowest score of the season so far it wasn't the worst in the game. He will be a valuable hold for you if you can with him being able to cover two positions on your bench.
Hall-Kahan took 9 marks and had 23 disposals as he continues his great form and shows that he was certainly a must have from the mid season rookies.
The Lachie Schultz injury may open the door for Mitch to come back into the side this week if Lachie misses games.
Mitch had his second game with just the 8 disposals. He does have that small forward role so is ok as a bench cover for you.
Fitzgerald was fantastic with his 31 disposals. He is one you could loop with each round to try and get him on your field. He will be a popular stand in for owners of Horne-Francis.
Fitzgerald was ok with his 24 disposals but he had just 50% efficiency. He isn't the points machine we had hoped for but he is delivering enough for your bench.

We have been waiting for Joel's debut since he was picked up in the mid season draft. He racked up 26 disposals and had 5 clearances. He is one that will be heavily traded in despite his upcoming bye.
Just 2 disposals and 2 marks for Bamert this week and he did drop a few marks. His spot in the side could be in jeopardy this week.
Bamert kicked a goal from his 8 disposals with this his lowest score so far. He isn't going to be a big scorer but if you got him for the bench then he looks like he may hold his spot.
Bamert had a good second game with 15 disposals and 7 marks but he isn't one of the mid season draftees that you would want to bring in.

The mid season draftee was good on debut with a goal and 11 touches as he looked good to the eye but he didn't reflect that in his SuperCoach scoring unfortunately. There are other mid season guys to get in before him.
Annand had his best score this week from his 13 disposals.
Annand was ok with his 7 kicks and 3 handballs but really he didn't have a big night in the loss.
Just 7 kicks no handballs and 5 marks with this his lowest score of the season. You didn't get him in for growth or to be on field from now on so as long as he plays that is all we need.

notes.note: Just the 8 touches for Lake and a low score. He isn't in your side to be on field so just the bench cover.
Lake's second game yielded just the 6 disposals with the 7 tackles saving it. He isn't your best trade in option this week.
First game had 11 disposals at 72%. He looked good and if he can back this up and hold his spot he could be worth a look.
Francou's second game was another great one with 15 disposals and 5 tackles. If you needed a downgrade then he would be a great option.
Great debut for Francou who is a ball magnet. 18 disposals but he laid 9 tackles which led the game!
Herbert was great again this week thanks to 10 marks and his 20 disposals coming at 95% efficiency. He would be a great loop player for you.

Herbert had his lowest score so far from his 19 disposals. He is still making money but you probably don't have the trades left to make the most of it. Importantly he should hold his spot which will see him valuable on your bench.

Herbert's second game was better than his first with his 15 disposals and 6 marks seeing him as the equal second highest scorer for the Eagles. Whilst we won't be using him for cash generation he will be good bench cover.
Herbert had his first game and was impressive as a mid season draftee. 15 disposals 6 marks at 86% will see him another popular downgrade this week.
